# Features

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-features.py from the provider's registered types. Do not edit. -->

Everything you can manage on MTN Cloud with your account: 103 resources and 100 data sources. The cloud (`MTNNG_CLOUD_AZ_1`) is found automatically, so you never configure it.

MTN Cloud's own names are used throughout: **MTN Network**, **MTN Router** and **MOS** (MTN Object Storage).
